subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

I need to spend some time fixing the __disorder__ of my bookshelves.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Regulate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'disorder'** refers to a state of confusion, lack of organization, or mess.
 
• **In the context **of the sentence, it suggests that the bookshelves are not neatly arranged or are in a state of chaos.
 
• The correct **antonym** for** 'disorder'** in this context is** 'Regulate'.**
 
• **'Regulate' **means to control or maintain the rate or speed of (a machine or process) so that it operates properly.(नियामक)
 
• **In the context** of the sentence, it implies bringing order or an organized system to the arrangement of the books.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Regulate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Condition' **(स्थिति) generally refers to the state of something or someone. It doesn't precisely indicate the act of bringing order.
 
• **'Chaos' **(अराजकता) is actually a synonym for 'disorder', not an antonym. It means complete confusion and disorder.
 
• **'Plague'** (महामारी) primarily means a contagious bacterial disease characterized by fever and delirium, or any contagious disease that spreads rapidly and kills many people. It doesn't indicate the act of bringing order.
